name: GhostDatePickerCalendar
description: Binds GhostCalendar to the picker: display-only committed value or pending range anchor, select-driven commits, and a default header and grid.

slots.name: default
slots.description:
Custom `GhostCalendar*` part composition. Defaults to a header with
previous/next month buttons and heading, followed by the grid.
